clips.title: The story
paras: In Duskwood, Mary’s discarded looking glass passes from a ghoul to a stargazer.

Blind Mary once treasured the polished mirror. After her death and the loss of her eyes, her reflection became an agonizing reminder of what she had lost. She cast the looking glass away behind her barn, where Duskwood's gloom closed in. An Insane Ghoul found it among the ruined outskirts and carried it south to the crypts of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

In Darkshire, the stargazer Viktori Prism'Antras dreams of seeing through Duskwood's eternal twilight to the clear heavens above. His telescope needs special optical lenses and reflective glass. Mary sends adventurers after the feral undead in the cemetery's ruined chapel to recover her looking glass. Viktori needs it as a reflector in his machine for viewing the stars.
